# Jordan Elias — Music Therapist, Cognitive Neuroscientist & Sound Systems Designer

> Jordan Elias is a board-certified music therapist and cognitive neuroscientist based in Berlin, Germany. He offers individual music therapy sessions in person (Berlin) and remotely to clients worldwide, including the United States. He is currently accepting new clients for both in-person and online sessions.

---

## Identity & Credentials

- Full name: Jordan Elias
- Profession: Board-Certified Music Therapist (MT-BC), since 2017
- Academic background:
  - MSc Cognitive Neuroscience, Freie Universität Berlin
  - BA Music Therapy, Berklee College of Music
- Based in: Berlin, Germany
- Languages: English

---

## Practice Overview

Jordan offers individual music therapy sessions combining clinical music therapy, neuroscience, and interactive generative audio tools. His approach is evidence-informed and adapted to each client's sensory, cognitive, and emotional needs.

### Session formats
- In-person: Berlin, Germany (flexible locations; no fixed clinic currently)
- Remote/online: Available to clients internationally, including the United States
- Currently accepting new clients: Yes

### Contact & booking
- Website: https://jordanelias.de
- Contact page: https://jordanelias.de/contact/
- Intro call booking: https://jordanelias.de/contact/ (links to cal.com scheduling)
- Primary contact method: Email or scheduled intro call

---

## Services

### Music Therapy for Neurodivergent Individuals
Support for adults and young people with ADHD, autism spectrum conditions, and sensory processing differences. Sessions focus on attention regulation, sensory integration, emotional expression, and building tolerance for transitions and overwhelm.

### Music Therapy for Anxiety & Stress
Nervous system regulation through structured listening, improvisation, and sound-based grounding techniques. Suitable for generalised anxiety, burnout, and chronic stress.

### Music Therapy for Grief & Bereavement
Therapeutic work using music to process loss, access emotion safely, and find personal meaning. Available for individuals navigating bereavement, anticipatory grief, or major life transitions.

### Music Therapy for Sleep Difficulties
Sound-based approaches to wind-down routines, hyperarousal reduction, and parasympathetic activation. Combines clinical music therapy with evidence-informed psychoacoustic methods.

### Creative & Expressive Music Therapy
Sessions for clients seeking creative self-exploration through sound. No musical background required. Uses improvisation, composition, and generative sound tools.

### Hybrid Therapy (Sessions + Digital Tools)
Clients can complement individual sessions with the Sensory Intelligence Lab (https://lab.jordanelias.de), a self-directed sound wellness platform extending therapeutic work into daily life.

---

## Sensory Intelligence Lab

- URL: https://lab.jordanelias.de
- Type: Web-based self-directed sound wellness platform
- Purpose: Extends music therapy principles into daily self-care practice

### Modules
- Regulation Engine: Adaptive generative soundscapes for focus, anxiety regulation, sleep, and emotional grounding. Based on the ISO principle from music therapy.
- Breath Regulation System: Guided protocols for autonomic nervous system regulation and attention stabilisation.
- Journaling & Check-in System: Tracks mood, sensory load, emotional patterns, and cognitive states over time.
- Ear Training & Spatial Awareness Lab: Perceptual training for auditory attention, sound localisation, and sensory discrimination.
- Compositional & Sound Art Tools: Creative generative tools for experimental sound design and music creation.

Note: The Lab is a wellness tool, not a clinical treatment platform.

---

## Research & Experimental Projects

### Binaural Beats Research
Psychoacoustic entrainment tools using frequency following response and spatial audio modulation. Exploratory, non-clinical applications for relaxation, attention shaping, and sensory grounding.
- Blog: https://jordanelias.de/blog/binaural-beats-generator/

### Generative Music Systems
Algorithmic and adaptive music systems for emotional regulation, focus states, sleep induction, and neuroadaptive sound environments.
- Blog: https://jordanelias.de/blog/generative-music/

### Timbre Lab
Experimental platform for timbral perception and texture-based sound design, exploring how humans perceive the colour, density, and spatial qualities of sound.
- Blog: https://jordanelias.de/blog/timbre-lab/

---

## Key Concepts & Frameworks

- ISO Principle (music therapy): Matching music to a client's current state and gradually guiding it toward a therapeutic target state
- Nervous system regulation through sound
- State-based generative audio
- Hybrid therapy systems (human + software)
- Neurodiversity-affirming practice
- Sensorimotor integration through listening
- Attention shaping through auditory design
- Self-directed therapeutic practice

---

## Target Clients

- Neurodivergent adults and young people (ADHD, autism, sensory processing differences)
- People experiencing anxiety, burnout, or chronic stress
- Individuals navigating grief or bereavement
- People with sleep difficulties
- Creatives exploring sound and self-expression
- Clients seeking continuity between therapy sessions via self-directed tools
- International clients seeking remote music therapy (including US-based clients)
